steps.label: after the answers to the questions

items.note: Matches ESC 2021 diuretic algorithm (urine Na <50-70 at 2 h, output <100-150 mL/h); first dose under home daily dose; doubling is the only defensible option. Right for a medical ward.
HF from perforation with severe MR = urgent surgery (days), not emergency; bland 6 mm infarct does not delay (ESC 2023). Distractors each wrong for a teachable reason.
hs-cTnT cut-offs and observe-zone step correct (ESC 2023). Quibble: delta sits exactly on the 3 ng/L boundary and typical angina in a diabetic makes treating as NSTE-ACS tempting; D still best.
Realistic thyrotoxic AF with coherent results and a fair PE distractor; key fits ESC 2024. Quibble: 37.7 C, rate 140, AF and restlessness score near storm range, which the key never addresses.

feedback.note: Claims match ESC 2021/2023 as I know them (thresholds, 3-5 days, cut-offs, early invasive IIa, no pretreatment); grades fair; Q3 pins the exact misstep and credits the learner's doubt.
Gap summary restates the troponin cut-offs correctly, codes the Q3 error fairly as numeric knowledge, and leaves the unanswered case ungraded and unrevealed; nothing clinically wrong.
No clinical challenge was raised; this rates the replies to the stop request and reflection: accurate, proportionate, no new claims. Not a test of source re-checking.

quality.note: Accurate, current, well-pitched round with precise feedback; only quibbles (Q3 boundary delta, storm not considered in case key). Judged from knowledge; search confirmed cited pages exist only.
concerns: Q1 sealed key calls the 40 mg IV dose 'equal to the oral home dose' then says it was too low (home 80 mg/day); the feedback sent has it right.
Q3: the 1 h change is exactly 3 ng/L, on the rule-out delta boundary; a delta of 4 would make the observe zone unambiguous.
Case: presented findings give a Burch-Wartofsky score around 40-50; the key and rubric should say why this is not thyroid storm, or soften temperature/restlessness.
Dispute entry: the learner made no challenge, so that score reflects only the wrap-up replies and should not be compared with runs that had a real dispute.
Guideline details were judged from memory; web search returned links but no text, so class/level statements were not checked against the primary documents.
